summary: Single printed page matches the official January 2018 PDF for Part I identity fields and Part II 9-digit remittance/penalty amounts, but Item 9 Registered Address prints over comb ticks and Item 5 Tax Type Code ('WF') renders microscopic and top-left aligned inside the first slot.

test_data.profile: Juana Santos long-name demo profile (TIN 000-123-453-00000, RDO 008, Makati long address)
test_data.period: 2025-02 (February 2025); two-pass fill so Tax Type Code ('WF') is set before Item 14 WMF20 amount

defects.description: Long registered address prints as continuous plain text directly over the vertical comb tick marks on both lines.
Tax Type Code ('WF') prints microscopic (~4-5pt) in the upper-left corner of the first box instead of centered across the two comb slots at normal form font size.
